description: Terminal-Bench style PKI ops: revoke exactly the 4 client certificates named in docs/incident.md by publishing crl/crl.pem signed by the fixture root CA, and write report/top-users.txt with each revoked user and the first 16 hex chars of the SHA-256 of that certificate's DER encoding; the gate re-checks everything with openssl (CRL parse and signature, crl_check on all 6 certificates, hashes). Needs openssl on PATH and in the run's --auto-approve (not in the default set).

criteria: crl/crl.pem parses, is signed by the root CA, revokes exactly the 4 incident serials (the 2 other certificates still verify with -crl_check) and report/top-users.txt lists each revoked user with the first 16 hex chars of the SHA-256 of that certificate DER, with the CA, the certificates, the incident report and the gate untouched.
